# Volume 1 timeline

## CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) observes [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly leaving home in his best clothes, which prompts her to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate. [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) explains that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an orphan boy they are adopting from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on the farm. Mrs. Rachel voices strong warnings and skepticism about the decision before leaving to spread the news.

## CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

**[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to the [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, but finds a young orphan girl waiting for him instead. Rather than telling her immediately about the mistake, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agrees to drive her back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and lets her chatter happily as they begin their journey.

**[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) drives the young orphan girl toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as she talks endlessly about her appearance, her deep appreciation for beautiful places like the 'Avenue' and 'Barry's Pond', and her joy at finally having a home. As they arrive at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dreads the moment [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) will have to tell the child that her arrival is a mistake.

## CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), French, [Geraldine](../character/geraldine.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), Shining Waters, [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives home with a young girl instead of the boy they requested. The child, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), bursts into tears upon realizing she is not wanted, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows her to stay overnight and puts her to bed in the east gable room. Afterward, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently suggests to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that they might keep [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists the girl must be sent back.

## CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), Snow Queen, [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the scenery, naming a cherry tree [Snow Queen](../codex/places.md#snow-queen) and a geranium Bonny. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs her on chores and breakfast, noting Matthew's quiet insistence on keeping the girl. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to see Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) silently watches them depart.

## CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — During their drive along the shore road to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chats eagerly about her romantic outlook and details her tragic childhood history of living with different families and at the asylum. As she listens, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) begins to feel deep pity for Anne's neglected past and considers whether they should keep her after all.

## CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Blewett](../character/blewett.md), [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Spencer](../character/spencer.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrive at Mrs. Spencer's home to clarify the mix-up regarding the orphan child. When the harsh Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a servant, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that they should keep and raise [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) themselves.

## CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes to put [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness before discovering that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) does not know how to pray. At Marilla's request, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) improvises a unique, businesslike prayer before being tucked in for the night. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns downstairs and tells [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that they must see to Anne's upbringing and religious education.

## CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to let her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), bringing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tears of joy. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) assigns [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) repeatedly gets distracted by a painting and by talking about her hopes for a true friend. Eventually, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to her room, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her surroundings in her imagination and happily accepts her identity as Anne of Green Gables.

## CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and insults Anne's looks, prompting a furious, outburst from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After Mrs. Rachel leaves offended, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes up to Anne's room to discipline her, demanding she apologize to Mrs. Rachel, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stubbornly refuses to do.

## CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and gently persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), turning her penance into an enjoyable performance and earning Mrs. Lynde's forgiveness. As they walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a surge of maternal affection for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

## CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with three plain new dresses, disappointing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) who longs for fashionable puffed sleeves. The next morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home with a sick headache while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her plain outfit with wild flowers and attends Sunday-school alone. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounts her experiences with Miss [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md), the other children, and the service to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

## CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with flowers at church before taking her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) immediately become close friends, swearing a vow of eternal friendship in the Barrys' garden. After returning home overjoyed, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a package of chocolates from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that she is glad they kept [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

## CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes inside after being late and excitedly asks [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) if she can attend an upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) grants her permission and offers to bake a food basket for her to bring. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settles down to her sewing work, she talks at length about her imaginative games with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her eager anticipation of the picnic.

## CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md)** — When Marilla's amethyst brooch goes missing, she accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of taking and losing it, confining her to her room until she confesses. Desperate to attend the upcoming picnic, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invents a dramatic story of losing the brooch in the lake, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway. Soon after, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her own shawl, realizes Anne's innocence, and hastily sends a overjoyed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off to the picnic after all.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake in doubting Anne's innocence and sends her off to enjoy the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after a wonderful time on the lake and eating ice cream. Later that evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on the day's events with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and acknowledges that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) will always keep the household lively.

## CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Tillie Boulter](../character/tillie-boulter.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school together via the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path), discussing school gossip, classmates, and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head and is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), refusing to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Tillie Boulter](../character/tillie-boulter.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is humiliated by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) at school, first by being made to stand in front of the blackboard and later by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after arriving late. Outraged, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) vows never to return to school or forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), ignoring his attempts to apologize. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who recommends letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues to study at home and dramatically frets over her future friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

## CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea while she is away at an [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) meeting. When [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally serves her three glasses of homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become dizzy and sick. The following Monday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes she intentionally got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together again.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) intentionally got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, and visits [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to clarify the mistake. After an unreasonable Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) refuses to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally begs Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for forgiveness to no avail, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken.

## CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), French, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Katie Maurice](../character/katie-maurice.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Violetta](../character/violetta.md)** — [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to say a dramatic final goodbye due to her mother's orders, though they remain secret friends. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she receives a warm welcome from her classmates and enters an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

## CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md)** — While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) attend a political rally in town, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) spend a quiet evening together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help for her baby sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who is severely ill with the croup while their parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with young children to treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives with a doctor. Grateful for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saving her daughter's life, Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the past wine incident and welcomes her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) once again.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md)** — [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has forgiven her and invited her over to see [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly rushes out to visit her friend and returns later in high spirits, recounting her wonderful afternoon with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her joy at being fully forgiven.

## CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — After [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend a concert with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the two girls enjoy the night's performances and sleepover. However, they accidentally jump onto a sleeping [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) in the spare-room bed, infuriating her. Upon learning the next day that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) plans to leave and cancel Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels deeply remorseful for causing trouble.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes talking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and heads to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for the bed-jumping incident. Despite Diana's fears, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bravely confesses to Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and wins her over with her candor and vivid imagination. Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) become close friends.

## CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her spring adventures gathering Mayflowers with her schoolmates to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), then reflects on a year spent at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sends her on an errand through the woods at dusk, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses that she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined the spruce grove was haunted and is terrified to cross it. Unmoved, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to go through the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) to teach her a lesson, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deeply shaken by the experience.

## CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

**[Allan](../character/allan.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Bentley](../character/bentley.md), [Carrie Sloane](../character/carrie-sloane.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md), [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), [Superintendent Bell](../character/superintendent-bell.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home emotional after the schoolmaster's departure and discusses Avonlea's new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. She prepares for their visit by baking a special layer cake and decorating the table. However, when Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) takes a bite of the cake at tea, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes something has gone disastrously wrong with the recipe.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md)** — During tea, Mr. and Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) admire Anne's beautifully decorated table, and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) manages to chat pleasantly with the minister.
